Our expertise

Every great experience
starts with a spark.

One creative partner. A world of possibilities.

01 Events & experiences +

Exhibitions, bazaars, launches, retreats, and corporate gatherings that bring people together. Our profile includes Dubai Tourism at Hyatt Regency, Ethio-con Construction Exhibition, and a Bedele new bottle launch.

02 Brand activations +

Bring a brand into people’s everyday lives through engaging activations. Our experience includes Demera, dart and wheel-of-fortune activations, and regional campaigns with Bedele beer.

03 Film, TV & advertising +

Television shows, film-related events, and TV and radio advertisements. Our work includes holiday television shows, Buhe Fest on EBC, the Turmi film production inauguration, and collaboration with Ethio Films on the Gumma Film Award.

04 Music & live entertainment +

Concerts, stand-up comedy, DJ competitions, and live music. From Ye Harar Leza comedy to reggae at Club H2O and New Year’s Eve concerts in Jimma, we help make live entertainment memorable.

05 Sports & tournaments +

Shared excitement on and off the field. Our portfolio includes the Safaricom football tournament in western Ethiopia and kerembula tournaments with Bedele beer.
